task.name: Sixteen integer points with many four-point lines and no five collinear
task.family: science prize g four point lines
task.description: construct() -> exactly 16 distinct integer points [x, y] with |x|, |y| <= 1000 and no five collinear. Maximize the number of lines containing exactly four of the points (exact). Integer configurations are a restriction of the real problem; the real value 15 for n = 16 is an upper reference, not a documented integer optimum.
